_comment: S2.5 CHARACTER ingest scope for the Unofficial Baldur's Gate 3+ Universe Seed. Pulls post-BG3 canon character profiles (companions + key NPCs) into clean JSON records under content/worlds/<world_id>/characters/<slug>.json, which ClawDnD can later load as NPCs of the 'baldurs-gate' world. TEXT/DATA ONLY — no images are fetched or committed (portraits are handled separately, local-only). Unlike manifest.json (lore, single Fandom wiki), characters span TWO wikis with DIFFERENT licenses, so each source carries its own wiki host, MediaWiki script_path, license, and attribution string. A title that doesn't resolve is skipped, not fatal.

sources._comment: bg3.wiki is a STANDALONE MediaWiki (1.43.x), NOT Fandom. Its API lives at /w/api.php (scriptpath '/w'), pretty URLs at /wiki/$1. License per https://bg3.wiki/wiki/bg3wiki:Copyrights — content on/after 2024-07-20 is dual-licensed CC BY-SA 4.0 AND CC BY-NC-SA 4.0; older content is CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 only (NonCommercial). ClawDnD is a non-commercial fan project, so both options are satisfied; we attribute with a back-link per the wiki's stated requirement, and carry the NonCommercial caveat.

sources._comment: forgottenrealms.fandom.com is a Fandom wiki (CC-BY-SA, per https://www.fandom.com/licensing). API at /api.php (scriptpath ''). Used for the Forgotten Realms figures whose canon predates BG3 (Jaheira, Minsc, Withers/Jergal) and for deeper FR background; bg3.wiki is preferred for the post-BG3 companion roster.
